packageRules.description: Group all dev dependency updates into a single PR

The React Native toolchain must match the react-native version, so it moves only in a deliberate RN upgrade. Keep it out of the dev dependencies group and create its PR only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.

4.26.0+ use React.ComponentRef in codegen specs (src/fabric/**); RN 0.83.4's parser only accepts React.ElementRef, so codegen fails and pod install breaks. 4.25.2 is the newest safe release. Lift once RN is upgraded.
